title: Energy Conservation Act, 2001 (as amended 2022) - Section 14AA
version: Act No. 52 of 2001 (Amended by Act 19 of 2022)
notes: Provides statutory mandate for Carbon Credit Certificates (CCC) and CCTS trading.

title: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, 2023 (S.O. 2825(E))

title: CCTS Amendment Notification - Offset Mechanism (S.O. 5369(E))
notes: Introduces project-based Offset Mechanism for non-obligated entities.

title: Detailed Procedure for Compliance Mechanism under CCTS (Version 1.0)

authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
title: Greenhouse Gases Emission Intensity Target (Amendment) Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 25(E))
notes: Notifies unit-level targets for Refinery, Petrochemicals, Textile, and Aluminium Category 2.

title: Lok Sabha Question No. 336 Answer - Transition of 7 Sectors and 490 Entities
notes: Confirms 7 notified CCTS sectors: Aluminium, Cement, Chlor-Alkali, Pulp & Paper, Petrochemicals, Refinery, Textile.

title: Terms and Conditions for Purchase and Sale of Carbon Credit Certificates Regulations, 2026
notes: Governs CCC trading on Power Exchanges, order matching, settlement, and market surveillance.

title: Methodologies and Tools under Offset Mechanism (12 Notified Methodologies)
